module_signature.description: Serial load enable; shifts din in while high
module_signature.name: load_en

module_signature.description: Serial data input, key MSB-first then plaintext MSB-first
module_signature.name: din

module_signature.description: Serial unload enable; shifts ciphertext out while high and done is asserted

Implement PRESENT-80 block cipher reference model following the contract exactly.
FSM states: IDLE=0, LOAD=1, ENCRYPT=2, DONE=3
Reset is asynchronous active-low; clears all state immediately when rst_n==0.
Load phase: 144 bits shifted MSB-first into {key_reg[79:0], state[63:0]}.
Encrypt phase: 32 cycles; rounds 1-31 do addRoundKey+sBox+pLayer+keySchedule, round 32 does only addRoundKey.
Key schedule: rotate left 61, sbox top nibble, XOR round index into bits 19:15.
Unload: MSB-first, pauses when shift_out_en is low.
load_en at any time outside LOAD resets to LOAD state and clears done.
